description.content: Browse every task of the current Gradle project in the DSH right Sidebar, grouped into folders by the group each task declares; double-click one to run it with the project wrapper and a chosen JDK, with the build output streamed back into the panel terminal.
在 DSH 右侧边栏浏览当前 Gradle 项目的全部任务，按声明的 group 分文件夹展示；双击任务即可用项目 wrapper 和选定的 JDK 运行，输出实时回传到面板终端。
